source: T-6310: the bytes (UTF-8) each part of the lead's context may take per call. skill_listing is measured live by test_docs (the descriptions Sampo adds to the model's skill listing, which Claude Code re-sends after each compaction); session_start is the SessionStart cap the footprint gate checks (hooks.CTX_BUDGET; bench_hooks --inject measured 669 in a fresh project); post_tool_use is set from the measured largest Sampo note (T-6310, transcripts since 2026-11-18). skill_body is test_docs' per-SKILL.md cap: the bodies are re-sent whole after a compaction. sampo cost --sessions names each part over its budget per session (bytes per call = the part's bytes over the session's turns). Raise a budget only with a note in its what field.

skill_listing.what: Sampo's share of the model's skill listing: skill, command and workflow descriptions (T-1253, listing_bytes in test_docs)

session_start.what: the SessionStart additionalContext (the hooks.CTX_BUDGET cap, which hooks counts in characters: the same number in bytes only for ASCII text; the requests and reboot notes ride in it too)

post_tool_use.what: Sampo's own PostToolUse additionalContext on one call (measured on transcripts since 2026-11-18: 25 Sampo notes, mean 111 chars, largest 317; the other plugins' notes and the compact hook's updatedToolOutput are not counted; the full batch paragraph a session's third edit gets once, which is over this size, is pinned by BatchNoteOnce and excluded from the per-call measure)

skill_body.what: one Sampo SKILL.md body, which Claude Code re-sends whole after each compaction for every invoked skill (test_docs measures every plugin/skills/*/SKILL.md; the detail lives in the skill's references/)
